description: Proposes clicking an element or typing into a field. The extension outlines the element and asks the user to approve; nothing happens unless they do. Use it to reach states that only exist after an interaction: an open menu, a validation error, the next step of a form. That is where most defects are. The user may decline. If they do, do not retry: ask them what they want instead.

element.description: A number from the most recent annotate_interactive on this tab. Easier and safer than retyping a selector.

selector.description: A CSS selector, or the visible text.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the user to answer.

name: propose_action
title: Ask the user to approve an action
